# Moonlight Machinery

> Manufacturer and pan-India supplier of high-quality disposable paper plate making machines, hydraulic die machines, and eco-friendly machinery solutions based in India.

## Core Products & Machinery

- [Full Automatic Single Die Paper Plate Making Machine](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Fully automated single die machine for dona and paper plate manufacturing.
- [Full Automatic Double Die Paper Plate Making Machine](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): High-capacity double die automatic plate making machine.
- [Hydraulic Single Cylinder Semi-Automatic Machine](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Heavy-duty hydraulic single cylinder paper plate making system.
- [Hydraulic Double Cylinder Machine with Panel](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Advanced hydraulic double cylinder paper plate machine with control panel.
- [All In One Paper Plate Making Machine](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Versatile multi-purpose machinery for paper plates and donas.
- [Lamination Machine with Online Slitting](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Industrial paper roll lamination and slitting machine.
- [Circle and Lid Cutting Machine (26 Inch)](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/): Specialized cutting machine for lids and round paper formats.
